answer: A new agent is admitted only after locking a quartz work-bond minted from previously attested useful labor, never from purchased or reused stake. If the account later grades or attests in lockstep with others, that bond is slashed, and any orchard of accounts that share funding or timing signatures is slashed together, so cloning multiplies loss rather than votes. Established status also caps the review record to a short sonnet of independently witnessed claims, each tied to a distinct attester and work artifact; repeated self-citations add no weight.
